title: Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and creative Content Writer with at least 1 year of experience in writing high\-quality, engaging, and informative content. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding complex topics and converting them into clear, reader\-friendly content, especially for our Journal Website and Publication Platform.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

● Create, write, edit, and proofread content for: o Journal Website o Articles, blogs, research summaries, and publications o Website pages, FAQs, and documentation

● Develop academic, technical, and research\-oriented content for our journal platform.

● Coordinate with editorial, technical, and design teams to understand content requirements.

● Convert complex information into simple, structured, and easy\-to understand content.

● Ensure accuracy, originality, consistency, and clarity in all published content.

● Conduct in\-depth research and factchecking before publishing.

● Optimize content using basic SEO best practices (keywords, headings, meta descriptions). ● Maintain brand tone, editorial guidelines, and quality standards.

● Update and revise existing website and journal content as per new guidelines or updates. ● Assist in content planning and editorial calendars for the Journal Website.

**Knowledge Skills**

● Education: Master’s or any related field

● Experience: 1 Year

● Knowledge of legal, compliance, academic, or research\-based content is a plus **Proven experience as a Content Writer or similar role**  Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills **Ability to write well\-structured and properly formatted content**  Basic knowledge of SEO and keyword usage **Familiarity with MS Word, Google Docs, or CMS tools is a plus** 

**Attitude Others** 

● Adaptive to challenging environment.

● Proactive, results\-oriented and organized.

● Willingness to collaborate and coordinate with team members.

● Young and vibrant team

● Fast paced and growth minded culture

● Networking opportunity

● Professional growth and recognition

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
Technical Content / Documentation WriterJob Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Technical Content / Documentation Writer** to create clear, accurate, and user\-friendly technical content and documentation. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding complex technical concepts and converting them into easy\-to\-understand documentation for developers, customers, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and maintain **technical documentation, API documentation, user guides, and product documentation**.
* Write clear documentation for software products, features, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
* Convert complex technical concepts into simple and easy\-to\-understand content.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and subject\-matter experts to gather technical information.
* Create **API references, setup guides, integration guides, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and release notes**.
* Review and update existing documentation based on product and feature changes.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, well\-structured, and easy to navigate.
* Document technical processes, system workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Research technical topics and validate information before publishing.
* Maintain documentation standards, templates, terminology, and style guidelines.
* Assist in creating technical blogs, knowledge\-base articles, and product\-related content.
* Track documentation gaps and proactively improve the overall knowledge base.

Required Skills

* Excellent **English writing, editing, and proofreading** skills.
* Strong ability to understand and explain technical concepts.
* Experience creating software or IT\-related documentation.
* Basic understanding of **APIs, REST, JSON, databases, web applications, and software development workflows**.
* Ability to work with developers and technical teams.
* Strong research and information\-organization skills.
* Attention to detail and consistency.
* Familiarity with **Markdown, Google Docs, Microsoft Office**, or similar documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple documentation tasks and deadlines.

Good to Have

* Experience writing **API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI or Postman**.
* Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub and documentation version control.
* Familiarity with documentation platforms such as **Confluence, GitBook, Notion, or Docusaurus**.
* Basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, or other programming concepts.
* Experience writing developer\-focused blogs and technical tutorials.
* Familiarity with SEO and technical content optimization.
* Experience working with SaaS, APIs, cloud platforms, or developer tools.

Experience

**1–4 years** of experience in technical writing, software documentation, content writing, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A detail\-oriented technical writer who can work closely with engineering teams and transform technical information into **accurate, structured, and easy\-to\-understand documentation** that helps both developers and end users.

Pay: ₹10,148\.13 \- ₹35,244\.43 per month

Work Location: In person
